body:
Cant reproduce that issues even with your "hack" code removed.

You likely have timing issues because that thread use is broken and unsafe. It is continuing the await spaghetti before the thread task is even finished and joined back with the main thread.

In Godot 4.5 regions are cached. So if you create them broken they stay that way until an actual extra update call, e.g. an enabled toggle, forces them to build a new iteration.

The reason you likely did not notice how broken that thread use already was is because in Godot 4.4 any map change did rebuild all the region iterations again, so basically any modification you did to the navigation map or regions fixed all the prev broken changes.
